scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Fixed five-row cyclic Fourier pattern only. Rank of maximal minors and their exact all-order incidence are proved by alternant factorization, squarefree-conductor reduction, and exhaustive exact arithmetic on a finite reduced universe. Does not classify arbitrary rows. Previous finite-order classifications and classical root-sum relations are acknowledged. No independent validation.
title: Exact singular-minor census for a five-frequency cyclic Fourier pattern
